evidence.why: Defines the exact pressed-buttons field and complete short-circuit escape gate.

facts.rationale: Corrects the obsolete input.x668 field spelling to the canonical input.pressed_buttons field while preserving the supported predicate order, object forwarding, and boolean outcomes.
facts.value: Receives a Fighter_GObj, obtains its Fighter from gobj->user_data, and first tests whether fp->input.pressed_buttons contains HSD_PAD_LR. Because the condition uses short-circuit OR, ftCo_800DF72C(fp) is evaluated only when the direct shoulder-button test fails. If either predicate succeeds, the original game object is passed to ftCo_8009B040 and the function returns true. Otherwise it returns false without entering a new action.
